resources.string: Choose which sites connect directly. Other sites keep their usual VPN route.
One domain or HTTP/HTTPS address per line, including subdomains. Always through VPN overrides the direct lists and domain zones. Apps excluded from VPN remain entirely direct.
Rules saved. Use Apply and reconnect to apply them.
Could not load site rules. Retry before editing.

Enter valid domains, one per line, up to 256 in each list. IP addresses and Xray expressions are not accepted.
For predictable routing, use the system DNS in your browser. Browser-owned secure DNS and ECH may hide the domain; unrecognized sites keep their usual route.
New rules apply to a new connection. A site may use other domains for sign-in or additional resources.
